title: Fluorescently Labeled Polyamine Uptake via Flow Cytometry
author: Sarah van Veen

steps.title: Detach and seed cells
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL TrypLE per well, incubate 5 min at room temperature protected from light, then seed the cells into a 12‑well plate and culture until they reach 70–80 % confluency on the day of the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 5 min at RT protected from light

steps.title: Replace medium with polyamine solution
steps.instruction: Remove the existing cell culture medium and add fluorescently labeled polyamines diluted in medium to each well, bringing the final volume to 1000 µL per well; keep the plate protected from light.

steps.title: Incubate with polyamines
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ for 2 h, ensuring protection from light.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL PBS per well and wash the cells.

steps.title: Block with BSA solution
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL per well of 2 % BSA (0.7 % solution) prepared in PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate for 5 min at 300 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL BSA + PBS + DAPI diluted 1:5000; keep the suspension on ice.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Keep the samples on ice until acquisition on the flow cytometer and record 10,000 live events per sample.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension through a nylon filter directly into flow‑cytometry tubes.

steps.title: Prepare single‑color controls
steps.instruction: Prepare single‑color samples as appropriate controls for the flow cytometry run.
